feeds.term: (Alzheimer) AND ("p-tau217" OR "plasma biomarker" OR "blood biomarker" OR "amyloid PET" OR "GFAP") AND (diagnosis OR detection OR screening)

feeds.term: (Alzheimer OR dementia) AND (prevention OR diet OR exercise OR "cognitive reserve" OR lifestyle OR "physical activity") AND (cohort OR "risk factor" OR longitudinal)

feeds.term: ("Alzheimer Disease"[Mesh]) AND ("Review"[Publication Type]) AND (overview OR introduction OR "current understanding" OR primer OR basics)

drug.title: Beyond Amyloid: Systemic and Brain Frailty as Determinants of Response to Anti-Amyloid Therapy in Alzheimer's Disease-A Conceptual Review.
drug.zh: 系统性和脑脆弱性决定抗淀粉样疗法疗效与风险，应纳入治疗决策框架。

drug.title: Exosome-Based Therapeutics in Alzheimer's Disease: Translational Perspectives Beyond Conventional Therapies.
drug.zh: 外泌体疗法凭借血脑屏障穿透力与多靶点递送优势，或成阿尔茨海默病超越现有疗法的关键策略。

drug.title: Cerebral amyloid-β burden and white matter injury: associations, clues for underlying mechanisms, and implication on cognitive trajectory after lecanemab therapy.
drug.zh: 仑卡奈单抗疗效受白质损伤动态影响，Aβ负荷可预测其进展。

drug.title: A Metabolomics-Based Strategy for Identifying Endogenous Inhibitors of IAPP Aggregation.
drug.zh: 代谢组学筛选出内源性代谢物可抑制IAPP聚集，为T2DM治疗提供新靶点。

drug.title: Donanemab for early symptomatic AD in the UK-indicated population: safety and efficacy in those who are non-carriers or heterozygous for APOE ε4.
drug.zh: 英国适用人群中，多奈单抗对APOE ε4非携带者及杂合子早期症状性AD患者安全有效。

drug.title: Anti-amyloid drugs: Integrated clinical pathways for treating older patients with frailty and dementia.
drug.zh: 抗淀粉样药物对衰弱老年痴呆患者疗效有限，应作为分层维度而非排除标准。

drug.title: Tau-targeting pharmacological strategies in neurodegenerative disease.
drug.zh: 靶向病理tau亚型而非泛tau清除，是tau蛋白病治疗策略优化的关键方向。

drug.title: Comparison of double-blind and open-label decline rates in lecanemab and donanemab trials in Alzheimer's disease.
drug.zh: 双盲与开放标签阶段斜率差异提示，仑卡奈单抗和多奈单抗的长期疗效或被高估。

mech.title: From Periodontal Pocket to Systemic Diseases: Mechanistic Insights Into the Role of Porphyromonas gingivalis in Host Pathology.
mech.journal: Journal of cellular and molecular medici
mech.zh: 牙龈卟啉单胞菌通过毒力因子破坏远端器官，桥接牙周炎与阿尔茨海默病等系统性疾病。

mech.title: [Noninvasive nanosecond transcranial pulsed electric fields: deep-penetrating, high-field stimulation for suppressing hippocampal amyloid-β and improving cognitive function in an Alzheimer's disease model].
mech.journal: Sheng wu yi xue gong cheng xue za zhi =
mech.zh: 纳秒经颅脉冲电场可无创深达海马，抑制Aβ沉积并改善AD认知功能。

mech.title: Novel Insights into the Pleiotropic Neuroprotective Action of Synthetic Halogen Free Thyronamine-like Analogues.
mech.zh: 新型无卤甲状腺胺类似物SG-22/SG-23通过多靶点机制在AD模型中发挥神经保护作用。

mech.title: Glycyrrhizin Ameliorates Learning and Memory Impairment via Inhibition of Neuroinflammation in an Alzheimer's Disease Mouse Model SAMP8.
mech.zh: 甘草酸通过抑制神经炎症改善SAMP8小鼠学习记忆损伤。

mech.title: Human Stem Cell-Derived Models of the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimmune System.
mech.zh: 人源干细胞模型可系统再现阿尔茨海默病神经免疫紊乱，助力机制研究与药物筛选。

mech.title: Cerebral Intramural Cells: A Missing Cellular Link Between Vascular Aging and Alzheimer's Disease.
mech.zh: 脑内壁细胞连接血管老化与Aβ清除障碍，或为AD关键机制。

mech.title: Putative Modulation of OATP1A2 and P-gp Expression at the Blood-Brain Barrier by Nrf2-PXR: An Associative Hypothesis for Amyloid-β Transport in Alzheimer's Disease.
mech.zh: 提出Nrf2-PXR互作调控血脑屏障Aβ转运蛋白的关联假说。

mech.title: MALDI Mass Spectrometry Imaging in Alzheimer's Disease Lipidomics: Matrix Selection, Spatial Lipid Pathology and Emerging Analytical Strategies.
mech.zh: MALDI质谱成像揭示AD脂质重塑呈区域及病变特异性，选对基质与极性是关键。

dx.title: Diagnostic accuracy of plasma p-tau217 against amyloid PET: A meta-analysis of technical platform variability and ratio versus single marker comparisons.
dx.zh: 血浆p-tau217诊断淀粉样病变准确率高，但平台间差异显著，联合Aβ42比值未显著提升效能。

dx.title: Multiplexed EDL-FET biosensor with tannic acid stabilization for simultaneous p-Tau217 and Aβ42/Aβ40 detection in plasma and whole blood from stroke patients.
dx.zh: 单宁酸稳定的八通道EDL-FET生物传感器可同时检测血浆及全血中p-Tau217与Aβ42/Aβ40，助力卒中患者AD早筛。

dx.title: Overview in Electrochemical and Electrical Biosensors for Determining Blood Protein Biomarkers of Alzheimer's Disease.
dx.zh: 血液蛋白标志物电化学生物传感器有望实现阿尔茨海默病低成本无创早筛。

dx.title: Neuroimaging Epicenters as Vulnerable Nodes in Plasma p-tau217/Aβ42-Positive Alzheimer's Disease.
dx.zh: 血浆p-tau217/Aβ42阳性AD的神经退行性“震中”锚定默认网络及边缘系统，并可由网络脆弱指数实现个体化预后预测。

dx.title: Head-to-head comparison of plasma biomarker assays across platforms for amyloid pathology in a multicenter cohort.
dx.zh: 多中心头对头比较显示，p-tau217检测平台间性能差异显著，含Aβ42比值者诊断效能更优。

dx.title: Emerging diagnostic biomarkers and therapeutic targets in Alzheimer's disease.
dx.zh: 综述AD病理机制，聚焦新兴诊断标志物与治疗靶点及递送策略。

dx.title: Diagnostic value of blood p-tau subtypes in Alzheimer's disease progression and pathology: systematic review and meta-analysis.
dx.journal: European archives of psychiatry and clin
dx.zh: 血液p-tau亚型对AD进展及Aβ病理诊断价值存在差异，p-tau217表现最优。

dx.title: CT1812 Attenuates Surgery-Induced Cognitive Impairment and Modulates TMEM97- and PGRMC1-Associated Hippocampal Stress Responses in Aged Mice.
dx.zh: CT1812通过调节TMEM97/PGRMC1通路减轻老龄小鼠术后认知损伤。

prev.title: Lifestyle activities and risk of incident dementia from linked insurance claims in the Baltimore Experience Corps Study.
prev.journal: The journals of gerontology. Series B, P
prev.zh: 晚年活动多样性与频率均降低痴呆风险，基于15年保险数据。

prev.title: Associations between essential trace elements and Alzheimer's disease and related dementias.
prev.zh: 七种必需微量元素联合暴露与阿尔茨海默病及全因痴呆风险显著相关。

prev.title: HIV-1 Tat and gp120 as key drivers of neurodegeneration in the central nervous system.
prev.zh: HIV-1 Tat和gp120蛋白在抗病毒治疗下仍持续驱动中枢神经退行性病变，是HAND发病的核心机制。

prev.title: Cognitive Screening as a Gateway to Cerebral Microbleed Detection in Atrial Fibrillation: The DAME Study.
prev.zh: 房颤患者认知筛查可预警脑微出血，辅助抗凝决策。

prev.title: Dietary Patterns and Cognitive Decline in Older Adults: Findings from the Western Australia Memory Study.
prev.zh: 西澳老年人研究提示，特定饮食模式与认知衰退关联受APOE基因型影响。

prev.title: The Brain-Muscle Axis in Neurodegeneration: Linking Dementia, Sarcopenia, and Exercise-Mediated Neuroprotection.
prev.zh: 综述揭示痴呆与肌少症互为因果，运动可通过脑-肌轴双向缓解。

prev.title: An Integrated Model Based on Gut Microbiota and APOE Genotype for Predicting Dementia Risk.
prev.zh: 整合肠道菌群与APOE基因型可精准预测痴呆风险，优于单一指标。

prev.title: Reduced Serum PON1 Lactonase Activity Is Associated with Mild Cognitive Impairment and Mixed Dementia.
prev.zh: 血清PON1内酯酶活性降低与轻度认知障碍及混合性痴呆显著相关。

intro.title: Human Stem Cell-Derived Models of the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimmune System.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是用干细胞造出迷你人脑模型，帮我们看清老年痴呆时脑内免疫细胞怎么捣乱，好为未来找药指路。

intro.title: Overview in Electrochemical and Electrical Biosensors for Determining Blood Protein Biomarkers of Alzheimer's Disease.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是用一滴血测阿尔茨海默病早期信号的新方法，比现在抽脊髓液或做脑扫描更便宜、更轻松，将来普通人体检就能早发现。

intro.title: Microglia in Alzheimer's disease: Insights into disease progression and therapy.
intro.zh: 大脑里的清洁工一旦罢工，病就加重；搞懂它们罢工的原因，才能找到延缓老年痴呆的新药。

intro.title: Menopausal insomnia as a modifiable node of dementia risk: Mechanistic insights and intervention strategies.
intro.zh: 更年期睡不好可能增加将来得老年痴呆的风险，但睡好了就能降低这个风险，所以女性要重视改善睡眠。

intro.title: Advances in the clinical application of mesenchymal stem cells for neurological disorders.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是用干细胞治疗老年痴呆等脑部疾病的最新进展，对普通人来说，就是了解未来可能多一种延缓病情的新希望。

intro.title: Gantenerumab for Early Alzheimer's Disease: An Updated Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
intro.zh: 这药想清掉大脑里的垃圾蛋白来延缓早期痴呆，但新数据说效果一般，别指望它能治好。

intro.title: Distinct roles of AMPA receptor subunits as potential therapeutic targets in Alzheimer's disease.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是大脑里负责记忆的“信号开关”出了问题会得老年痴呆，科学家正研究怎么精准修好它，帮患者延缓记忆衰退。

intro.title: Peroxynitrite: A potential therapeutic target for Alzheimer's disease.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是，一种叫“过氧亚硝酸盐”的坏分子在老年痴呆里捣乱，科学家正研究怎么抓住它来治病，对咱们普通人来说，就是未来可能多一种防痴呆的办法。
